label: Absorbing Medium
help: A box of homogeneous absorbing medium, such as tinted water or ink, centred on the entity and turned by its Transform. Light crossing a length d inside keeps exp(-absorption × d) of each channel. It is invisible in raster and render graph views; RT1 reference captures with CPU oracle or GPU compute transport it.

properties.label: Width
properties.help: Extent of the box along local X, before the Transform scale.

properties.label: Height
properties.help: Extent of the box along local Y, before the Transform scale.

properties.label: Depth
properties.help: Extent of the box along local Z, before the Transform scale.

properties.label: Absorption R
properties.help: Linear Rec. 709 red absorption coefficient sigma_a per metre. Zero is vacuum; 1/sigma_a is the distance over which red light falls to 1/e (37%).

properties.label: Absorption G
properties.help: Linear Rec. 709 green absorption coefficient sigma_a per metre. Zero is vacuum; 1/sigma_a is the distance over which green light falls to 1/e (37%).

properties.label: Absorption B
properties.help: Linear Rec. 709 blue absorption coefficient sigma_a per metre. Zero is vacuum; 1/sigma_a is the distance over which blue light falls to 1/e (37%).
